Name: Seeds are rare
Author: jahangmar
Description:
[size=4][b]What it does:[/b]
[/size][list]
[*]Removes seeds (except tree saplings) from all stores.
[*]Seed Makers are moved to the farming 1 tier and are less expensive to build.
[*]Only way to get seeds is by finding mixed seeds and processing crops in a Seed Maker.
[/list]The mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3012]Better Mixed Seeds[/url] which allows every seed to be found in mixed seeds.

[size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and ﻿ unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Download  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3012]Better Mixed Seeds[/url] and ﻿ unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]. You should have a [font=Courier New]Mods/SeedsAreRare[/font] and a [font=Courier New]Mods/CP-SeedsAreRare[/font] folder afterwards.
[*]Optional: Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/935]Better Quality More Seeds[/url]﻿ ([url=https://smapi.io/mods/#Better_Quality_More_Seeds]unofficial update[/url]﻿) and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]. Seed Makers will give more seeds for better quality crops.

[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][size=4][b]
Uninstall[/b][/size][size=4][b]:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Remove the folders [font=Courier New]SeedsAreRare[/font] and [font=Courier New]CP-SeedsAreRare[/font] in your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.
[/list]You will still be able to make Seed Makers (with the vanilla recipe) if you already learned it but everything else will work as in vanilla.


[size=4][b]Configuration:
[/b][/size]Start the game with this mod at least once to generate the config.json in the [font=Courier New]SeedsAreRare[/font] folder.
[list]
[*] exclude_rare_seed: The "Rare Seed" will still be sold.
[*]exclude_<shopname>: <shopname> will still sell seeds if this is set to true.
[*]﻿exclude_night_market: same as above but affects all shops at the night market. exlude_traveling_merchant does not affect the night market traveling merchant.
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Tested with Stardew Valley 1.4 on Linux
[*]Tested in Multiplayer
[*]Seems to be compatible with mods using the json assets mod to add new crops to the game. Tested with Bonster's Crops.
[/list]
[url=https://github.com/jahangmar/StardewValleyMods/tree/master/SeedsAreRare_Project]source code
[/url]
If you like this mod you might also like my mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3654]Working Fireplace[/url].
